intro: Guided practice paths for guitar skills and playing styles.

locked.title: Build a roadmap around your own goal
locked.body1: Player Roadmaps are made to measure: you describe what you want to play, and the coach lays out the phases, exercises, lessons and songs that get you there. Other players' roadmaps show up here too, so you can see what they are working towards.
locked.body2: Every one of these roadmaps is generated by an AI model, and every generation costs real money. riff.quest runs on donations, so this tab sits behind the supporter badge. The Mastery Roadmaps tab stays free for everyone.
locked.body3: Any donation, even the smallest one, unlocks Player Roadmaps for life. No subscription.
locked.email: Pay with the email this account is on, so the donation lands on the right account.
locked.email_known: Pay with the email this account is on — {{email}}, so the donation lands on the right account.

kit.title: Practice kit
kit.body: Open a resource to work with it, then tick it off. Ticking everything completes the step.

lesson_modal.description: The lesson plays here while a stopwatch tracks your practice. Finishing logs the time.

check.writing_body: The first time a phase is checked, the coach writes its questions from the steps you practised. Takes a moment.
check.first_phase_done: Phase 1 is yours. On to the next one.
check.need: You need {{need}} of {{total}}. Reread the steps that tripped you up — the answers are in them — and come back.
check.intro: {{questions}} quick questions about what you practised in this phase — the chords, the counts, the motions, the why. Get {{pass}} right to clear the phase. You can retake it as many times as you like; only your best run counts.
check.read_only: Only the player whose roadmap this is can sit its checkpoints.
